newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens lower, seen stuck in tight range.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens lower, seen stuck in tight range.

text.p: The UK's leading FTSE 100 index opened slightly weaker on Tuesday in line with a softer Dow but losses were expected to be capped as shares continue to range trade amid a distinct lack of institutional activity.
The FTSE was off 4.9 points at 4,323.8 by 0741 GMT. Decliners were in a four-to-one majority.
Recent trading volumes have been subdued by the proximity to the election on May 1 and the possibility of an interest rate rise shortly afterwards. The market's lethargy is expected to continue.
